messages:
pagerbot: PAGER: HIGH auth-rate spike detected from inference-edge-2 (rule: auth.unusual.rate). oncall: ken-oncall. link: https://pager.redwood/incident/1744444444

ken-oncall: Ack — I'll take this. spinning up bridge and checking logs now.

sam-eng-sre: Seeing ~600 401s in 3m from ~120 unique IPs hitting /v1/inference/ws with the same svc-token header pattern. Looks like credential spraying or token replay.

ken-oncall: Any customer impact visible yet? errors or increased latency?

tom-cs: No incoming CS tickets. No 5xx spikes in user-facing routes. I'll prep a standby customer template just in case.

maria-devex: Found 3 objects in staging-logs-bucket with debug dumps that include Authorization headers. Bucket is staging-only but headers contain valid-looking bearer tokens for svc-infer-proxy.

aliya-sec: @ken-oncall @sam-eng-sre please treat as sensitive. Steps: 1) isolate objects, 2) scrub and preserve copy for forensics, 3) rotate affected service tokens, 4) start KMS rekey if needed, 5) CTI enrich IPs.

ken-oncall: Isolating now — changing S3 ACL and copying to secure forensics bucket.

sam-eng-sre: Quick mitigation: adding ephemeral WAF rule to block top offending IPs and rate-limit the /v1/inference/ws route. Applying config now.

ken-oncall: Initiating service token rotation for infer-proxy (rolling update):
```
# rotate svc token for infer-proxy
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/infer-proxy SVC_TOKEN=rot-1744444444
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/infer-proxy
```

ken-oncall: Rotation command submitted; watching rollout. Expect KV cache invalidation ~30s after pods restart.

maria-devex: Forensics: saved copies at s3://forensics/staging/1744444444, metadata preserved. Redacted copy uploaded to shared drive for triage. No evidence yet of production bucket read.

aliya-sec: I'll open an internal incident ticket and start KMS key rotation for the service principal. Also launching enrichment on the 120 IPs and submitting to abuse feeds.

tom-cs: Draft customer note: "We detected unusual auth attempts against our inference endpoint and rotated related service tokens as a precaution. There is no indication of customer data accessed in production. We're investigating and will update." Will hold send until we confirm no prod exposure.

legal: Loop me in if we confirm any exfil or PII in the staging dumps. Keep chain of custody for preserved objects.

ken-oncall: Quick status: WAF rule applied, infer-proxy rollout at 3/3 pods restarted, S3 objects isolated. No 5xx or user-facing errors. Continuing monitoring for 15m.

pagerbot: Bridge created: https://zoom.redwood/bridge/1744444444 — participants: ken-oncall, sam-eng-sre, aliya-sec, tom-cs, maria-devex, legal.

ken-oncall: I'll own the postmortem timeline and remediation list. Action items: wipe leaked staging objects after forensics, rotate any tokens found in dumps, run audit across other staging buckets, expand WAF rules, and follow up with customers if needed.

sam-eng-sre: Adding monitoring alert to detect similar token pattern reuse across prod and staging.

aliya-sec: Filing incident ticket INC-1744444444 and scheduling short blameless postmortem.

tom-cs: Ready to notify customers if we see any sign of production access. Keeping support on standby.

ken-oncall: Thanks all. Ping here with any change. :thumbsup:
